messages.text: My miner arrived faulty
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill

I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sorry it landed in that state, let's find out what's going on.

To start, two things:

1. Which model is it (for example NerdQaxe++, Hammer DC06, Nexus S1)?
2. What exactly happens when you plug it in: nothing at all, screen on but no hashrate, an error on the screen, a noise or smell?

A photo of the screen or of the unit powered up helps a lot if you can send one.
I think I just lost hal

Still here, no worries.

Back to your miner: which model is it, and what happens when you power it on?
Bc04

Got it, Hammer BC04.

What happens when you plug it in? Pick the closest:

1. Nothing at all: no lights, no fan, blank screen
2. Fans spin and screen lights up, but it never starts hashing
3. It hashes but far below the expected rate
4. Something physical: cracked screen, broken fan, loose part in the box
5. A noise, a smell or heat (pop, burning smell)
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

I can see your screenshot: Harlo OS public beta 0.2.101, web UI at 192.168.68.77, with a red "HARDWARE PROBLEM: BOARD INITIALIZATION FAILED" banner. Give me a moment, I am checking the current Harlo OS version and what that exact message means on the BC04.
Read harlolabs.com
Searched the web · Harlo OS "board initialization failed" hardware problem BC04
Searched the web · Harlo Labs Harlo OS firmware latest version download
Searched the web · "BOARD INITIALIZATION FAILED" miner Harlo
Read harlolabs.com

I could not find an official write-up for that exact wording in the Harlo docs, so I will not guess what it means. Two things will settle it quickly.

First a clean restart, because this message also appears after a bad boot:

1. Unplug the BC04 at the wall and leave it off for 30 seconds
2. Plug it back in and let it run about 2 minutes untouched
3. Reload 192.168.68.77 in your browser

Then tell me what you see: does the banner come back, and on the dashboard what does the ASIC or chip count show (for example "0 chips")?
My phone says this when I log in. Unfortunately, I’m at work now, so this is stuff I tried last night

Understood, no problem doing this from memory for now.

From last night: after you unplugged it and powered it back up, did the same "BOARD INITIALIZATION FAILED" banner come back every time, or did it ever boot normally and start hashing?
No, since the screen went blank on the other Lily go, it’s never hashed

Let me make sure I have the picture right, because it sounds like there may be two things going on.

Is this one BC04 whose LILYGO screen went blank (and the web UI at 192.168.68.77 now shows the hardware banner), or is it a second separate unit that has the blank screen?
Yeah, the blank screens on the lilygo was the orignalone, and it all started with a boot loop, it then progressed to it not hashing. Then processed to black screen

Thanks, that sequence helps: boot loop, then no hashing, then blank screen, while the web UI still answers. So the controller is alive and it is the mining board side that is failing to come up.

Next step, for tonight when you are back at the unit: a full factory flash of Harlo OS, not an OTA update. You are on public beta 0.2.101, and a clean flash from offset 0 rules out a corrupted firmware image, which is exactly what a boot loop can leave behind.

1. Open the flasher at harlolabs.com in Chrome or Edge on a computer
2. Pick the Hammer BC04 profile
3. Connect the unit with a USB data cable (a charge-only cable will not work)
4. Choose factory, not OTA. It wipes your settings, so you will re-enter your pool and Wi-Fi after

One quick question meanwhile so I can plan the next step: do you have a second power supply of the same rating you could swap in, or only the one it shipped with?
I then had a second lilygo screen and attached it and put harlo os on it I then go it to show something and it showed this
Used rma verdict
